en: Local TRAINERS come here to\npractice.
You're decent.
All POKéMON have weaknesses.\nEven the strongest ones.\pThat's why it's best to raise\nPOKéMON of different types.
Dad took me to a great party on\nthe S.S. ANNE at VERMILION CITY.
I'm not mad!
On the S.S. ANNE, I saw TRAINERS\nfrom around the world.
I'm a cool guy.\nI've got a girlfriend!
Aww, darn…
Oh, well.\nMy girlfriend will cheer me up.
Hi!\nMy boyfriend is cool!
My conditioning isn't the best…
I wish my boyfriend was as good\nas you.
I had this feeling…\nI knew I had to battle you!
I knew I'd lose, too!
If your POKéMON gets confused,\nswitch it out.\pThat's a good tactic.
My friend has many cute POKéMON.\nI'm so jealous!
I'm not so jealous!
You came from MT. MOON?\nMay I have a CLEFAIRY?
I just got down from MT. MOON,\nbut I've still got gas in the tank!
You worked hard!
Drat!\nA ZUBAT bit me back in that cave.
I'm off to see a POKéMANIAC's\ncollection at the cape.
You done got me, and real good,\ntoo!
The POKéMANIAC sure lives up to\nhis name.\pHis collection includes many rare\nspecies of POKéMON.
You're going to see BILL?\nFirst, we battle!
You're something.
The trail below is a shortcut to\nCERULEAN CITY.
SEA COTTAGE\nBILL lives here!
This cape is a famous date spot.\pMISTY, the GYM LEADER, has high\nhopes about this place.
Hello, are you here alone?\pIf you're out at CERULEAN's cape…\nWell, it should be as a couple.
